What we covered: • Anthropic Launches Claude Ship to Automate Pull Request Approval • Meta Launches Muse AI Agent for Personal Shopping in the UK • Google DeepMind says Gemini agents helped improve quantum algorithms for fusion, chemistry, and enzymes Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship to Automate Pull Request Approval: what actually changes, who benefits, and what remains uncertain? What to watch next: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed.
